'''Veerla Mere''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] and course coordinator of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Pit Screamers]] during the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]]. Her first victory in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] inspired [[Raossk]] to join the Screamers, becoming the gang's leader by [[3626 BBY]]. Her brother [[Jorn (Pit Screamers)|Jorn]] was also a member of her swoop gang but was killed a year before the All Worlds Rally while practicing in a course on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
